Structured Reading Progression

The 3-Level Phonics & Reading Journey

Every student receives 100% English, 60-page Scandinavian-Modern workbooks paired with daily World GK discovery footers on pages 4–59.

Level 1 • Teal Edition 60 Pages

Fox A

Jr. KG / Ages 4–5

Builds joyful letter-sound foundations with built-in 4-line tracing for A–Z, CVC words, and starter Sight Words — no separate tracing book required.

  • ✓ A–Z phonics sounds & letter formation
  • ✓ Built-in 4-line tracing (A–Z, CVC & Sight Words)
  • ✓ 100% English workbook + World GK footers (pp. 4–59)
Level 2 • Coral Edition 60 Pages

Bunny B

Sr. KG – Std. 1 / Ages 5–7

Transitions young learners from single sounds to smooth blending, digraphs, vowel teams, and confident short-sentence reading.

  • ✓ Blending, consonant digraphs & long vowel patterns
  • ✓ Guided word-building & sentence reading practice
  • ✓ 100% English 60-page edition + World GK footers
Level 3 • Gold Edition 60 Pages

Bear C

Std. 1 – Std. 3 / Ages 6–8

Completes mastery of all 42 phonics sounds, alternative spellings, fluent paragraph reading, and independent vocabulary decoding.

  • ✓ Complete 42-sound mastery & tricky word fluency
  • ✓ Independent reading passages & spelling confidence
  • ✓ 100% English 60-page edition + World GK footers

Everything Teachers & Students Need

Complete Learning & Teaching Kit

Thoughtfully designed classroom materials that make teaching effortless and keep children engaged every single session.

3 Student Workbooks

100% English, 60 pages each (Fox A, Bunny B, Bear C). Level 1 includes built-in 4-line tracing for A–Z, CVC & Sight Words.

Marathi Teacher Guide

Step-by-step Marathi teaching handbook built specifically for Maharashtra centers so every teacher delivers accurate phonics sounds.

42 Sound Flashcards

High-clarity classroom flashcards covering all 42 phonics sounds for rapid visual drills, blending games, and group practice.

A–Z Wall Charts

Vibrant Scandinavian-Modern classroom wall charts that create an immersive daily English phonics environment.

Unique Workbook Feature • Pages 4–59

Built-in World GK Discovery Footer

Every workbook page from Page 4 to Page 59 introduces a country's flag, capital, and continent — sparking global curiosity alongside phonics practice.
